title: dacrycarpus cumingii
intro: Dacrycarpus cumingii, commonly known as the Philippine pine or yellow pine, is a species of coniferous tree in the family Podocarpaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Dacrycarpus cumingii include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which have been shown to aid in reducing fever, relieving respiratory issues, and protecting against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to act as a bronchodilator, expectorant, and antiseptic, and its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, among others.
